closingKeywordWhy: This is the labels-first slice of #618. The threshold auto-tuner the issue is named for is deliberately not built: the report never prints or proposes a threshold, and tuning stays blocked until a gate holds 30 adjudicated labels.

deviations: Naming registry: canary-hawk-dove marked shipped, not reserved, because ts/test/bop-name-registry.test.ts requires shipped once agents/skills/claude-code/canary-hawk-dove exists (precedent #1779). assumptions: No human was available; routine questions took the recommended option.

Derived rules follow ADR 0025 and ts/src/guardian/adjudication.ts, as the coordinator corrected: fp: suppression is noise, any other reasoned suppression is intentional (excluded from precision), and a coverage-verified finding gone from a later vouching run of the same PR while its file is still in that run's diff is real.
Rejected and not built: 'a later fix: commit touches the flagged path means real', because its false-label risk is high on high-churn files.

Floor: 30 adjudicated (real + noise) labels per gate, mirroring PRECISION_FLOOR. Skills ship without the engine, so the constant cannot be imported across the package boundary; it is mirrored and a parity test reads ts/src/guardian/adjudication.ts.

Finding identity reuses agents/skills/lib/scan-baseline.mjs identityOf (file, rule, anchor), hashed with the gate. For the guardian the fields are path, kind and unit. An id names an identity, not an occurrence.
When labels for one finding disagree, the latest ledger line wins; earlier ones stay for audit.
Default ledger path .canary/hawk-dove/ledger.jsonl follows canary-katana's .canary/ convention; SKILL.md says to commit it, since .canary/ is gitignored here.

Report exit codes 0/1/2/3 with exit 3 as the default abstention (no --strict), expressed by an optional advisoryCode on the skill gate-conformance row (the same shape #1779 adds; whichever lands second resolves a small conflict).
No directory walk exists: --from must be a single regular .json file, and a directory is rejected by name.
GFM autolinks are broken by inserting U+200B into every ://, www. and @ in Markdown output.
